claim_class: Monte Carlo convergence in the number of CORAS draws of a conditional predictive score; no physical attribution
scope: Finite equal-weight 2MRS-constrained CORAS residual draws at fixed CF3-calibrated growth and bulk; fitted selection per fold. Conditional predictive score, no calibrated p or joint survey error covariance.
note: Seeds named or removed here are diagnostics; the reported score keeps every draw. More draws, not exclusion, are the remedy for a non-converged mixture.

review_corrections.change: New output. Every coras_draws* score in CF4_MARKS128 gets leave-one-draw-out influence, the score without the most influential draw and without named seeds, single-draw scores, a random-subset Monte Carlo mean/SD versus n (with and without the most influential draw) and the SD over random disjoint halves next to the fixed R105 half split; the u=0 and offset scores are judged separately; statements are generated from these numbers.
